title: Hijacking 3D Generation: Targeted Adversarial Attacks against Image-to-3D Models via Prefix Trajectory Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.34075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online services that deploy Image-to-3D models enable users to generate high-quality 3D assets from a single image. However, the generated 3D geometry can violate content policies and cause broader security risks. To prevent such content, these services typically use policy-restricted inspectors to examine uploaded images before generation. Since the inspector examines only the visible content of the input, a visually benign image can still induce the generation of policy-restricted 3D geometry. However, turning this vulnerability into an effective attack is non-trivial in the black-box setting: global backpropagation through the long DiT generation trajectory is difficult to fit, while different image preprocessing pipelines across services can substantially reduce transferability. In this paper, we present PTA3D, a targeted adversarial attack against Image-to-3D models that addresses these challenges through Prefix Trajectory Alignme

translated_title: 劫持3D生成：通过前缀轨迹对齐对图像到3D模型实施定向对抗攻击
translated_abstract: 部署图像到3D（Image-to-3D）模型的在线服务使用户能够从单张图像生成高质量的3D资产。然而，生成的3D几何可能违反内容政策并带来更广泛的安全风险。为防止此类内容，这些服务通常使用受策略限制的检查器在生成前审查上传的图像。由于检查器仅审查输入的可见内容，一张视觉上无害的图像仍可能诱导模型生成违反政策的3D几何。然而，在黑盒设置下将这一漏洞转化为有效的攻击并非易事：贯穿长DiT生成轨迹的全局反向传播难以拟合，而不同服务间不同的图像预处理流水线也会大幅降低攻击的可迁移性。在本文中，我们提出了PTA3D，这是一种针对图像到3D模型的定向对抗攻击，通过前缀轨迹对齐来解决上述挑战。
tldr: 该论文提出PTA3D，一种针对图像到3D生成模型的黑盒定向对抗攻击方法，通过前缀轨迹对齐绕过仅审查输入图像的内容检查机制，诱导模型生成违反内容政策的3D几何。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PTA3D, a targeted black-box adversarial attack against image-to-3D models that leverages prefix trajectory alignment to bypass input-image-only content inspection and induce the generation of policy-violating 3D geometry.
